raw_segments.text: He ground his teeth and sank into silence again.
Again Downia's image rose before him, just as she was when, after shooting the first
time, she had lowered the revolver in terror and gazed blankly at him, so that he might
have seized her twice over, and she would not have lifted a hand to defend herself
if he had not reminded her.
